**Implementation note:** min_variance weights, long-only and fully invested.

## Description

Choose weights that minimize estimated portfolio variance, subject to optional position and exposure constraints.

## Where it may fit

Risk-first mandates where covariance estimates are more trusted than expected-return forecasts.

## Vehicles

Equity, ETF and multi-asset portfolios; defensive smart-beta strategies.

## Required data

Asset return history, covariance matrix, investment constraints, liquidity and costs.

## Caveats

May overweight historically low-volatility or correlated assets; estimated risk can shift quickly.
